reviews.comment: Easy prof but I don't like that he uses zybooks (just a personal preference), and I feel like some of the labs were kind of a waste of time. Otherwise he's a pretty good lecturer and exams are reasonable (multiple choice w/ partial credit + you get a cheat sheet)

10 question multiple choice exams with partial credit for wrong answers. A goated professor with a goated system. Zybooks is annoying but does teach you the material and ensures good grades on homework. Whoever gave him the 1 star review was definitely just angry they got an 89 or something. This guy is great.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Bullard and even choose to join his lab. He is an extremely great prof since he always tries his best to help me learn more. He is passionate and his lecture is always clear. The only bad thing is that the exams were difficult and you have no choice but to understand everything on the textbooks and his notes.

Bullard is passionate about materials which is the only thing that can get you through the brutal 2 hour lecture. He will be sassy if you ask dumb questions. He allows cheat sheets with anything on them which is clutch. Tests were tough but not impossible. He's solid overall, but he doesn't post the completed lecture notes.

He's an extremely fair grader, and although the tests make up 70% of the class they aren't terrible. The homework was very annoying and not helpful for the tests at all. Lectures were boring and not helpful for the tests. He gives out formula sheets though and a good strategy is to fill them with examples from quizzes (free 100's) and hw questions.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Bullard's class. He is so genuinely passionate about the class and he was super accessible after class. Homeworks are really difficult, but he is very generous with partial credit on the exams to make up for that.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Bullard was great! The homeworks could be pretty rough, but he's available outside class to discuss. His exams are 2/3 multiple choice and 1/3 free responce, and he still gives partial cred for multiple choice if you show your work. He also posted his lectures after class.
Very amazing lecturer and passionate about material science. Really enjoyed his class and had a good time learning from him last semester.

Very enthusiastic and an overall fun class to be in. Dr. Bullard is just a great teacher and communicates his expectations really well. The tests were easier than anticipated. The homeworks were helpful but honestly much more difficult than the test materials.

He really cares about his students. His way of teaching is the best. Even though is new to TAMU he is very good at teaching. Tries to make class interesting by warm up and funny quizzes. Would love to take his course again
Good professor, but challenging class work hard. His lecture notes and his practice test were best to study for exams.

Dr. Bullard is one of the rudest and weirdest professors I've had since coming to A&M. I've never written a review before, but I feel like I should strongly suggest you don't take him. The class itself isn't hard but he's just not a good professor.

It's clear in each class that Professor Bullard really cares about his class. You will definitely learn a lot in his lectures and the work is by no means taxing. I would be happy taking any class from him in the future

Loves his subject and cares about his students. Really wants us to learn and structures his class so we can do well and show how much we've learned. He tests based on his lectures, not the book, but uses the book for hw. Tries to make the lectures interesting and gives us breaks in the middle so we can relax.
You need to go to lecture to do well. He tries to split the 2 hour block with a 5-10 minute break so students dont lose their minds. Loves his subject, and is a very nice guy. Would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy
